preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 200,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000 (inclusive).

preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct nodes U and V, where 1 ≤ U, V ≤ N.

postconditions.description: For each query, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda: (lambda U, V: (lambda DIS_V_LCA: (lambda: any((lambda s1, s2: (lambda: any(s1[i] == s2[j] for i in range(len(s1)) for j in range(len(s2))))(s1, s2) and (lambda s: s == s[::-1])(s1 + s2)) for s1 in [s[:i] + s[i+1:] for i in range(len(s))] for s in [s1 + s2 for s1 in [s[:i] for i in range(1, len(s))] for s2 in [s[i:] for i in range(1, len(s))] if s1 and s2]))(DIS_V_LCA))(U, V))(DIS_V_LCA) for U, V, DIS_V_LCA in [(int(u), int(v), DIS_V_LCA) for u, v, DIS_V_LCA in zip([line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and all(part.isdigit() for part in line.split()) and len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0] != 'Q'], [line.split()[1] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and all(part.isdigit() for part in line.split()) and len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0] != 'Q'], [DIS_V_LCA for DIS_V_LCA in []])])
postconditions.description: For each query (U, V), the output is 'YES' if there exists a concatenation of a non-empty subsequence of DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) and a non-empty subsequence of DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) such that the concatenated string is a palindrome. Otherwise, output 'NO'. Here, DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) is the string formed by characters on the path from V to LCA(U, V) excluding the character of LCA(U, V).
